[[Assassin]] trainer, [[Jinzo]], seeks to test your skills by having you destroy five [[Bone Horror|target minions]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = factions
| profession = Assassin
| primary = y
| secondary = n
}}

===Objectives===
* Talk to Jinzo again when you are ready to kill the target minions.
* Kill 5 target minions. [5..0] target minions remaining.
* See Jinzo for your reward.

===Early benefits===
*Jinzo will teach you the following skills when you accept the quest:
**{{skill icon|Fox Fangs}}
**{{skill icon|Death's Charge}}

===Rewards===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 50 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
Map travel to Shing Jea Monastery and talk to Headmaster Lee. Walk outside Shing Jea Monastery to Sunqua Vale. Then head up north, and walk for about 1 minute to reach Jinzo. Talk to Jinzo again to start the quest proper. Simply kill the five Bone Horrors as they appear to complete the quest. [[Vun Ying]], your fellow student, will help you out.

==NPCs==
===Allies===
[[Human]]
*{{a}} 1 (20) [[Vun Ying]]

===Foes===
[[Undead]]
*{{x}} 3 (22) [[Bone Horror]]s (five of them, but spawns one at a time)

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Jinzo
:''It is our solemn duty as Assassins to be quick and precise with our blades. Your prey should feel not a moment's pain; it must die before it knows you have struck.''
:''I trust your steel is sharp; this exercise will sharpen your mind. Instructor Su provided us with some [[Bone Horror|target minions]]. Kill 5 of them. And remember, every blade had two sides.''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = My blade will strike true.
| decline = My blades need sharpening.
| ask = This test requires that you kill 5 [[Bone Horror|target minions]]. Now, focus.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Jinzo
:''You did well.''
:''These were just mindless target minions. Some day your target will be someone's sister, husband, mother, or son. This knowledge is yours to bear.''
